workflow.name: string — human-readable name
workflow.trigger: string — when to use this workflow

steps.success_criteria: string — how to verify this step worked
steps.fallback: string — what to do if this step fails

workflow.learned_from: string — session or context where this was learned
workflow.success_count: number — how many times this workflow has been successfully executed
workflow.pinned: boolean — reserved for a future forgetting/pruning policy for this file, which does not exist yet (core.memory.sk has none defined) — currently always false, has no effect
workflow.project_only: boolean — true only for a workflow specific to this repo's own dev process, never meant for a project that installs the framework; absent or false for a normal reusable workflow. INSTALL_PROMPT.md Step 4 strips any project_only:true entry on fresh install (EP-75) — same treatment RELEASE/EVOLVE_BENCHMARK already get as commands

notes: Written by core.planning.sk's PLAN_EXECUTE step 7 (EP-74), only when a completed plan's step sequence is a genuinely repeatable pattern, not one-off work — offered to the user, never saved silently. Read by PLAN_WRITE step 1 (match on `trigger` before drafting a new plan from scratch, bump `success_count`/`last_used` on reuse).
